name: Action Link Formatter Links
description: Outputs action links inside a field's formatter, e.g. increment/decrement links on either side of the field value, replacing the whole field over AJAX.
project_description: Submodule of Action Link. Lets action links that control an entity field be output within that field's formatter, configured via the formatter's third-party settings. hook_field_formatter_third_party_settings_form() adds an 'Action links' checkboxes element listing the action links that target the field; hook_entity_display_build_alter() wraps the rendered field and injects the action link set (two directions placed before/after the value, otherwise after it). Provides an ajax_entity_field link style (extends the core Ajax style) that, on a successful action, returns the entire rendered field in all relevant view modes as AJAX ReplaceCommands so the updated value is shown, not just the link. Requires a core patch (drupal.org #2686145) to work on fields shown in Views.
